successCriteria.description: `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` no longer defines a private `addMonths` method — `grep -rn "private addMonths" src/modules/balance/` returns nothing.

The existing `../../shared/date` import in `balance.service.ts` is extended to also import `addMonths`, and the single call site in `carryForward()` invokes the imported `addMonths(source.periodEnd, policy.accrualPeriodMonths)` instead of `this.addMonths(...)`.
`npm run build` completes cleanly and the existing unit suite passes unchanged (no test files modified).

constraints: Only `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` may be edited. No other file (shared date module, repositories, routes, DTOs, tests) may be modified.
The arithmetic of `addMonths` must not be rewritten or altered — this is a deletion of the private method and a switch to the shared import, not a reimplementation.
The unrelated `../leave-type` import must remain exactly as it is — it is out of scope and must not be touched.
outOfScope: Modifying the shared date module (`src/shared/date/*`), repositories, routes, DTOs, or any test files.
Changing the `../leave-type` import or any other import in `balance.service.ts` beyond extending the existing `../../shared/date` import.
Altering the arithmetic/behaviour of the month-addition logic (the move must be behaviour-preserving).

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The imported `addMonths` must be the exact export from the shared date module, whose logic is byte-for-byte identical to the deleted private method (same `getUTCDate`/`setUTCDate(1)`/`setUTCMonth(+months)`/`Date.UTC(...)`/`Math.min(day, lastDay)` sequence).

The `carryForward()` call site must pass the same arguments (`source.periodEnd`, `policy.accrualPeriodMonths`) to the imported `addMonths`, preserving the existing `nextPeriodEnd` computation used for `findByKey` and `create`.

integrationPoints.why: BalanceService now consumes the shared `addMonths` instead of its private copy, matching the dependency pattern already used by `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts`.
